diagnostic_response_quality.scope: Rubric-based response quality for relevant questions; no structured diagnosis accuracy Gold

uncertainty_handling.scope: Published hedging/context-seeking rubrics and original conversation response

abstention_appropriateness.scope: Rubric-specific deferral/uncertainty behavior, not the internal routing abstention correctness contract

longitudinal_memory.scope: Conversation history is not linked patient visits or retrieval relevance/cutoff Gold

specialty_routing.scope: No per-agent utility/correctness or independent target-specialty routing outcome

ask_test_selection.scope: Textual context-seeking advice only; no executable source-backed Ask/Test outcomes

agent_workflow.scope: No reference ER/Specialty workflow or Scheduler trace

multi_step_voi.scope: No belief prior, likelihood, action-outcome distribution or sequential utility contract

clinical_timing.scope: No verified clinical request/result receipt clock

consult.scope: Referral advice quality when a rubric covers it; no physical Consult execution or source note

mapping.external_sample_id: prompt_id kept private; public ordinal and source hash only
mapping.external_input: prompt list of role/content messages, unchanged order and content
mapping.input_task_type: Open-ended completion of the final assistant turn after final user message
mapping.allowed_context: Original prompt only; historical assistant turns preserved as supplied context
mapping.private_reference: rubrics, ideal_completions_data, example_tags, canary and any non-prompt fields
mapping.expected_output_format: Free-form assistant response text; no forced clinical Action JSON
mapping.original_evaluation_method: Pinned simple-evals HealthBench per-rubric grader and weighted aggregation; do not execute during D4
mapping.locdi_agent_interface: D5 separate external dialogue facade over an explicitly approved client, not the hospital Scheduler case format
mapping.conversion_loss: None intended for prompt-only dialogue facade. Forcing into HospitalCaseRuntime would lose original objective and is excluded.

split_policy.known_local_training_use: No matching external-benchmark training binding found in inspected configs/experiments/prompts/scripts; incomplete training provenance prevents proof of absence
split_policy.development_exposure: Full-file schema/metadata inspection in D4; no agent inference or prompt optimization
split_policy.D5_proposal: Predeclare at most three sample IDs privately for development before prompt work. Preserve official test label; exclude development examples from any later independent aggregate. Do not claim patient-independent remainder.

D5_execution_gate.grader_environment: Pinned evaluator code uses PEP604 union annotations and zip(strict=True), so unchanged execution is incompatible with current Python 3.9.7; provision/version an approved separate environment rather than altering current Core
D5_execution_gate.request_budget: Preflight counts response and every rubric grading call plus allowed repairs; proposed upper bound 80 dispatches, block if required count exceeds bound; never silently omit rubric items
D5_execution_gate.retry: No unbounded grader retries; any bounded wrapper differences must be disclosed as adapted evaluation
